02 / THE PERSON BEHIND THE SYSTEMS

Engineering mindset.
Business perspective.

{ human }

Good software begins with understanding how people work.

I approach development through object-oriented thinking, clear component boundaries, debugging, and iteration. The goal is software that is easier to reason about, maintain, and evolve.

My background in government administration, business operations, retail, and customer service has exposed me to repetitive tasks, gaps in processes, and opportunities for better systems. That perspective shapes how I identify useful automation opportunities.

My work spans trading software, blockchain transaction monitoring, desktop AI experimentation, and Excel/VBA automation. These are different applications of the same interest: turning complex requirements into practical systems.
